fields.question_text: Which of the following taxonomic ranks is broader than class but narrower than kingdom?
Which of the following taxa includes the largest number of organisms?
Which of the following taxonomic categories is more specific than Family but broader than Species?
fields.option_a: Kingdom -> Class -> Order -> Family -> Genus -> Species
fields.option_b: Kingdom -> Class -> Order -> Family -> Genus -> Species

fields.question_text: Which of the following is correct about phylogenetic classification?
fields.option_a: It classifies organisms based on evolutionary history.
fields.option_b: It does not use fossil evidence

fields.question_text: Which scientist first defined the term "species" based on reproductive isolation?
Which of the following statements about cladistics is incorrect?
fields.option_a: Cladistics classifies organisms based on shared derived characteristics
fields.option_c: It groups organisms randomly without considering common traits
fields.option_d: Cladistics is used to construct phylogenetic trees
fields.explanation: Cladistics does not group organisms randomly; it classifies them based on shared derived traits and ancestry.
